title: Grade the MSRP domain-change to unsolicited GET_AVB_INFO path at pp_top (REQ-NET-002)
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## REQ-NET-002 (Milan 5.3.6.2, 4.2.7.2.1, shall) - audit verdict PARTIAL

Track the MSRP Class A domain (priority 3, VID 2 by default), adopt and re-declare a differing received Domain, and notify on change.

- In `hdl/` today: hdl/srp/KL_srp_domain.sv:67-72 DOMAIN_CHANGE strobe + class_a_prio/vid/adopted levels, :157,:184 strobe on revert and on adoption, :199-200 operating values; hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:474,:762 srp_domain_change_o, srp_class_a_prio_o/vid_o/adopted_o published, :2179 strobe from KL_srp_top, :1868 feeds the talker PCP-change flow, :3267 ORed into ev_avb_i (unsolicited GET_AVB_INFO).
- In `tb/` today: Tracking/adopt/re-declare/strobe graded: tb/srp_encoder/sim_main.cpp:582-590 D1 defaults, :613-624 D4 Lv+New + 'one DOMAIN_CHANGE strobe' + ADOPTED, :631-632 D5, :652 D6, :689-702 D8/D9 (README mutation M4 = 2 red); tb/srp_top/sim_main.cpp:696 'E: DOMAIN_CHANGE fired'; tb/pp_top/sim_main.cpp:7839-7849 S1 Domain New {6,3,2} byte-exact + class-D defaults, :8071-8088 S8 adoption {prio 3, vid 5}, GET_DOMAIN, Lv+New byte-exact. NOT graded: the AECP notification leg. pp_top's only differing Domain (:8071) is fed before any controller registers; the unsolicited GET_AVB_INFO arms cover gsi_avb_chg_i (:4772-4781) and gm_change_i (:4793-4805) only; tb/aecp_notify/sim_main.cpp:128 ties ev_avb_i to 0.
- Missing: The 'notify on change' half at the integrated top: no check that an adopted (or reverted) Class A Domain makes the processor send the unsolicited GET_AVB_INFO to a registered controller. Deleting the srp_evt_domain_change_w term from ev_avb_i (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:3267) leaves every suite green. (The msrp_mappings content of GET_AVB_INFO is the integrator's gsi answer by design, so only the trigger is in this repository's scope.)
- Searched with: evt_domain_change; srp_domain_change_o; DOMAIN_CHANGE; fv_domain; ev_avb_i; class_a_vid; GET_AVB_INFO (confidence: high)

## Acceptance

1. tb/pp_top: with a controller registered, feeding a differing Class A Domain declaration yields exactly one u=1 GET_AVB_INFO for AVB_INTERFACE 0, byte-exact, and no GET_AS_PATH.
2. An identical re-declaration (no DOMAIN_CHANGE) sends no notification.
3. Mutation record: removing srp_evt_domain_change_w from ev_avb_i turns the new check red.
4. Optionally the link-edge leg of the same OR term is graded in the same phase.

Matrix finding link: GAP-04.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
